overall_quality.evidence: Transformers and RNNs both handle sequences, but they do so in fundamentally different ways. RNNs process sequences in a sequential manner, one element at a time, which can be slow and inefficient for long sequences. Transformers, on the other hand, use a parallel approach, allowing them to handle sequences much more efficiently. They achieve this by using self-attention mechanisms that allow each part of the sequence to interact with every other part simultaneously. This parallel processing is a key difference and a significant advantage of transformers over RNNs.
